title: Patent enforcement and quality upgrading of exported products
summary: The paper evaluates how patent protection affects the quality of exported products across 43 advanced and emerging economies. R&D-intensive industries in countries with stronger patent protection produce and export higher-quality goods at a greater rate than similar industries in weaker-protection countries.
keyFindings: R&D-intensive industries in countries with stronger patent enforcement upgrade export quality faster.
The effect is larger for differentiated products and in developed or more technologically capable countries.
Patent policy should account for country-specific conditions.
methods: Cross-country differences in patent enforcement combined with cross-industry differences in R&D intensity, for 43 advanced and emerging economies.
